Good to know

Your questions, answered.

A few answers to help you get started.

What spaces do you work on?+

We work on homes, Airbnbs, salons, offices, restaurants, bars, clubs and other business spaces.

Can I see the design before work starts?+

Yes. Our 3D interior design service shows you how your space could look. You can review the layout, colours, furniture and lighting before building starts.

Do you work outside Nairobi?+

Yes. We are based in Ngara East, Nairobi, and provide interior design, fit-outs and custom furniture across Kenya.

How do I get a price for my project?+

Call or WhatsApp 0726 138 627. Tell us your location, the size of your space and what you need. The cost depends on the work, materials and furniture you choose.
